ECM-2124                                                                                                                about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 07-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech III Semester - Make up Examination, Jan - 2025  
  Object Oriented Programming [ECM-2124]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Briefly explain data abstraction in java.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Differentiate between call by value and call by reference with example.                     (3)  
  C)      Consider a class Student with name, roll number and an array marks[] to store the marks  
  of FIVE subjects as its private data members.  
  Include the following methods and constructors:  
  i) a display function to display the data members.  
  ii) a default constructor  
  iii) a constructor to initialize name and marks of the Student(Note: Each student has a  (5)  
  unique roll number generated by the program).  
  iv) a member function Avg() to calculate average of five subject marks of a student and  
  return the result.  
  In main(), create an array of students and initialize them appropriately and demonstrate  
  use of all the above functions.  
  
  2)           What is an abstract class? How an interface is different from abstract class?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss about the super keyword in java with example.                                       (3)  
  C)      Write a java program to do the following:  
  i. Accept a word from the user, create two threads.  
  ii. In the first thread, arrange the characters of the word alphabetically & display the  
  word                                                                                        (5)  
  iii. In the second thread, count the no. of vowels in the word and display it  
  iv. Once the two threads are complete, display " WORK COMPLETED"  
  
  3)           State the difference between String and StringBuffer class with example.  
  (2)  
  A)

  B)         Give the differences between Abstract class and Interface with example.                 (3)  
  C)         Design an interface called Shape with methods draw() and getArea(). Further design two  
  classes called Circle and Rectangle that implements Shape to compute area of respective (5)  
  shapes.  
  
  4)              Explain how dynamic method dispatch is different from compile time polymorphism?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain synchronization and how it is achieved in multithreading.                       (3)  
  C)         Write a Java program that prompts the user to enter a number to use as an array size, and  
  then attempt to declare an array using the entered size. If the array is created  
  successfully, display an appropriate message. Java generates a User defined exception  
  namely Check if you attempt to create an array with a negative size. Use a catch block (5)  
  that executes if the array size is negative, displaying a message  
  IncorrectArraySizeException that indicates the array was not created.  
  
  5)              Discuss how to set the priority to threads?  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain with an example how to restrict a generic type to a specific superclass or  
  interface.                                                                              (3)  
  
  C)         Create a generic interface with push, pop, isEmpty, isFull methods for stack and a  
  generic stack class to implement the same with necessary instance variables and         (5)  
  constructor. Write a test class to demonstrate stack for integers and strings.  
  
  
  -----End-----
